name: image-trail
title: 图像轨迹 Image Trail
description: 鼠标移动时沿路径依次甩出短暂的图片或视觉片段。

props.name: items
props.description: Visual items cycled through as the pointer moves.

props.name: children
props.description: Static content rendered inside the interaction region.

props.name: distance
props.description: Pointer distance required before adding another item, in pixels.

props.name: lifetime
props.description: Lifetime of each trail item in milliseconds.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Maximum number of trail items rendered at once.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Classes applied to every positioned trail item.

usage: `ImageTrail` 按指针移动距离采样位置，并循环使用 `items` 中的视觉内容形成短暂轨迹。组件限制同时存在的项目数，并在离场后清理节点，适合作品首屏、专题页和强视觉索引。
